Your input fields are:
1. `identity` (str): 
2. `day` (str): the day this reflection covers
3. `today_activity` (str): everything you saw and did today
4. `open_items` (str): unanswered items still pending
5. `prior_summaries` (str): your recent daily summaries
Your output fields are:
1. `reflection` (DailyReflection):
All interactions will be structured in the following way, with the appropriate values filled in.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
{identity}

[[ ## day ## ]]
{day}

[[ ## today_activity ## ]]
{today_activity}

[[ ## open_items ## ]]
{open_items}

[[ ## prior_summaries ## ]]
{prior_summaries}

[[ ## reflection ## ]]
{reflection}        # note: the value you produce must adhere to the JSON schema: {"type": "object", "$defs": {"MemoryBullet": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"importance": {"type": "integer", "maximum": 10, "minimum": 1, "title": "Importance"}, "refs": {"type": "array", "default": [], "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Refs"}, "text": {"type": "string", "title": "Text"}}, "required": ["text", "importance"], "title": "MemoryBullet"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "description": "What the day distilled to: bullets future-you needs, with the\nworld ids they concern and how much they matter.", "properties": {"bullets": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/MemoryBullet"}, "maxItems": 8, "minItems": 1, "title": "Bullets"}, "open_loops": {"type": "array", "default": [], "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Open Loops"}}, "required": ["bullets"], "title": "DailyReflection"}

[[ ## completed ## ]]
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Consolidate your working day into a durable note. Write three to
        eight bullets a colleague could act on tomorrow: decisions made,
        commitments given or received, risks noticed, threads left open.
        Rate each bullet's importance 1-10 and carry the exact world ids
        (thr-/tkt-/cnv-/doc-) it concerns. List open loops separately.
